summary: Antares Strategic Credit Fund II LLC filed an 8-K disclosing a regular and special distribution for common shares: gross regular $0.1915, net regular $0.1736, special $0.0105, total net $0.1841 per share, payable August 31, 2026 to holders of record July 28, 2026. The fund also reported receiving $1.1 million in subscriptions and continues a continuous private offering at NAV. NAV per share as of June 30, 2026 was $24.78; aggregate NAV $82.1 million; debt-to-equity ratio 1.03x. Routine distribution and fundraising update with no structural changes; watch future NAV trends and subscription momentum.
